verdict.rationale: mise documents development, test, and production config overlays, which let a project select a non-production environment. It also lists an optional task sandboxing control for commands that read, write, or reach more than they need. Both are thin mentions: sandboxing is off by default and Linux/macOS only. Bootstrap's --dry-run is only a preview, not sandbox isolation, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how the test overlay isolates production data, how sandboxing restricts file/network access, an AI-agent-specific sandbox workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: A task or command reads, writes or reaches more than it needs | Sandboxing | Off; Linux and macOS only
